aka: Thomas Pell, 1st Lord of Pelham Manor
occupation: Physician; founder of Westchester and purchaser of Pelham
bio: Thomas Pell (1608–1669), known as the 1st Lord of Pelham Manor, was an English-born physician who purchased Pelham and founded the town of Westchester in 1654. He was the second husband of Lucy Brewster. He died on 21 September 1669. He is connected to John's family only by marriage and has no blood tie to John.
